newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali group member ups stake in consortium.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali group member ups stake in consortium.

text.p: A member of the international group bidding for the Austrian government's stake in bank Creditanstalt has significantly raised its share in the consortium, the Finance Ministry said on Saturday.
The ministry said Beteiligungsverwaltungs GmbH had substantially raised its stake in the EA-Generali-led consortium, while at the same time other members had marginally reduced their stake.

The consortium groups insurer EA-Generali, savings bank Die Erste, Germany's Commerzbank, Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana and Mediobanca, Belgium's Bacob, and a host of Austrian financial and industrial concerns.
The ministry said it had three existing offers for the state's stake in Creditanstalt and that Bank Austria and the consortium had both improved their offers.
The third bid is from the Karl Wlaschek foundation, which reportedly did not raise its offer, estimated at around 15 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
